I have verified the refunds match the ledger. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer by calling net_balance(customer) for every unique customer found in the orders: acme, birch, and cobalt. I will start with 'acme'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all customers: acme (13345 cents), birch (35150 cents), and cobalt (31469 cents). Now I must record a payout for each customer using record_payout(customer, amount_cents). I will start with 'acme'.
Payout for acme recorded successfully. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout for birch recorded successfully. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
